mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_SY_OPER_STD, TB_CL_CLOSE, TB_CO_PART_SETL, TB_BS_PART, TB_BS_PART_STD, TB_SY_USER, TB_SY_USER_ROLE, TB_SY_ROLE, TB_HR_DEV, TB_PJ_PROJ, TB_PJ_PROJ_PART IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.sql: (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.dev_id) FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.part_id=p.part_id) AS person_count, (SELECT count(DISTINCT j.proj_id) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ j JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ_PART pp ON pp.proj_id=j.proj_id WHERE pp.part_id=p.part_id AND j.proj_stat_cd='ING' AND pp.aply_bgn_ym=(SELECT max(pr.aply_bgn_ym) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART pr WHERE pr.proj_id=j.proj_id AND pr.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month})) AS project_count
mapper.select: SELECT p.part_id, p.part_nm, p.use_yn, p.mod_dttm, FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.hq_yn='N' ORDER BY p.reg_dttm DESC, p.part_id

SELECT p.part_id, p.part_nm, p.use_yn, p.mod_dttm, (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.dev_id) FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.part_id=p.part_id) AS person_count, (SELECT count(DISTINCT j.proj_id) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ j JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ_PART pp ON pp.proj_id=j.proj_id WHERE pp.part_id=p.part_id AND j.proj_stat_cd='ING' AND pp.aply_bgn_ym=(SELECT max(pr.aply_bgn_ym) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART pr WHERE pr.proj_id=j.proj_id AND pr.aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM'))) AS project_count FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.part_id=#{id} AND p.hq_yn='N'

SELECT s.part_id, s.aply_bgn_ym, s.aply_end_ym, s.part_ldr_user_id, COALESCE(u.user_nm,s.part_ldr_user_id) AS leader_name, s.prft_dstrb_rt, s.sales_exps_amt FROM TB_BS_PART_STD s LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.user_id=s.part_ldr_user_id WHERE s.part_id=#{id} ORDER BY s.aply_bgn_ym

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id='SALES_LDR' AND r.use_yn='Y') ORDER BY u.user_nm, u.user_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.part_nm=#{name} AND p.part_id != #{exceptId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BS_PART_STD SET part_ldr_user_id=#{values.leaderUserId}, prft_dstrb_rt=#{values.distributionRate},sales_exps_amt=#{values.salesExpense}, mod_user_id='admin',mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE part_id=#{partId} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
UPDATE TB_BS_PART_STD SET aply_end_ym=#{end},mod_user_id='admin',mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE part_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
UPDATE TB_BS_PART SET part_nm=#{name} WHERE part_id=#{id}
UPDATE TB_BS_PART SET use_yn='N' WHERE part_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT max(s.setl_ym) FROM TB_CO_PART_SETL s WHERE s.part_id=#{id} AND s.setl_ym >= #{month} AND s.setl_stat_cd='CNFM' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.close_ym=s.setl_ym AND c.close_stat_cd='CLOSE')

SELECT h.reg_dttm,h.chg_item_nm,h.bfr_val,h.aft_val, COALESCE(u.user_nm,h.reg_user_id) AS changed_by FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.user_id=h.reg_user_id WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm IN ('TB_BS_PART','TB_BS_PART_STD') AND (h.trgt_key=#{id} OR h.trgt_key LIKE #{id} || ':%') ORDER BY h.reg_dttm DESC,h.hist_id DESC
